title: Assessment of Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair in Atrial Functional Mitral Regurgitation (ATRIAL-MR)
official: Assessment of Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair in Atrial Functional Mitral Regurgitation
summary: This investigator-initiated, multicenter, international, retrospective registry aims to investigate outcomes of patients with atrial functional mitral regurgitation, as treated in clinical routine.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* functional mitral regurgitation
* left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50%

Exclusion Criteria:

* age under 18 years
* known regional wall movement disorders
